name: Fire Alarm System
tagline: A realistic addressable fire alarm system: control panel, smoke and heat detectors, horns, strobes, sprinklers, and fire-ready woodland mansions.
description: A realistic, addressable **fire alarm system** for Minecraft. Build a control panel, tie detectors, pull stations, horns, strobes and sprinklers to it, and watch it behave like the real thing: smoke follows the air, doors matter, alarms latch until reset, and sprinkler heads pop one at a time.

list: **Fire Alarm Control Panel** with LEDs, LCD, ACK / SILENCE / RESET / DRILL / WALK TEST keys, an active-event list, a device list (change zones, disable, remove) and an 80-entry event history, plus a **Remote Annunciator**.

**Initiating devices:** manual pull stations, photoelectric smoke detectors, heat detectors, sprinkler waterflow and valve-tamper switches, and a standalone interconnected **smoke alarm** with test/hush and a battery that chirps when low.

**Notification appliances:** horn, strobe, horn/strobe, speaker/strobe and bell, all synchronised, with selectable tones (Temporal-3, March, Hi-Lo, Slow Whoop, Chime). SILENCE stops the sound but the strobes keep flashing.
**Outputs:** control relay modules (redstone on alarm, trouble or supervisory), magnetic door releases that close nearby doors, emergency lights and EXIT signs.
**Sprinklers:** heads with fusible bulbs, pipe, a riser with valve and flow switch, and a fire department connection. Heads need real pipe to a water supply and put out fires within range.
**Extinguishers:** a hold-to-spray fire extinguisher and a wall cabinet.
Synthesised sounds for every device, procedural textures and custom 3D models.
Place a **Fire Alarm Control Panel** on a wall and right-click it with the **Panel Programming Tool** to select it.
Right-click each device with the tool to learn it into the panel (up to 96 devices). Sneak and use the tool to remove one.
Right-click the panel with an empty hand to open its screen.

description: Alarms latch at the panel until RESET, and re-trip straight away if the cause is still there. A missing device raises a trouble signal, a closed riser valve raises a supervisory signal, and a new alarm re-sounds silenced signals.

Every woodland mansion comes with a complete, working system: a panel by the front door, exit sign, exterior bell, smoke and heat detectors on every floor, horn/strobes, emergency lights, door releases, pull stations and extinguisher cabinets, all linked to the panel. The mansion's illagers (vindicators, evokers, pillagers and illusioners) know the system: when one sees a fire it runs to the nearest pull station and pulls it.

list: `/firealarm tp <panel> [address]` teleports you to a panel or one of its devices, and `/firealarm list <panel>` lists them.
`/firealarm <panel> ack|silence|reset|drill|walktest|status` presses the panel keys remotely (operators).
`config/firealarm.properties` controls detector ranges, the smoke alarm battery, campfire nuisance alarms, mansion systems and raider behaviour.

description: Requires Minecraft 26.1.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, Java 25 and Fabric API. Singleplayer and servers.
